summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of Bata SIS platform. Backend: 44/44 API tests passed (auth, RBAC, dashboard, all 12 reports, exports, batches, insights, audit-logs, notifications, partners, fields, masters CRUD + duplicate 409, ops upload success + duplicate rejection, txt file rejection, upload preview, settings, users admin+RBAC+short password 400). Backend unit tests: 5/5 pass. Frontend: login works for admin/ops/mgmt; invalid credentials show error; 4 dashboard KPI cards render with correct testids; charts + recent batches render; Ingestion Batches page shows hero banner + 25 batch rows; Reports page lists all 12 reports with proper testids and export buttons; Review Queue exception-filter-type present; Masters masters-add-item-btn present; Insights page shows 22 rule-based items; RBAC nav enforced (mgmt nav excludes Upload/Review/Masters/Users/Partner/Email/Settings).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py + routers are reasonable size; no _id leakage observed in sampled responses.

Login submit button lacks type='submit' and a data-testid (e.g. login-submit-btn). Not blocking, but adding a data-testid would improve testability consistency (username/password inputs already have testids).
Audit endpoint is exposed as /api/audit-logs (not /api/audit). Consistent naming with other list endpoints would help. Not a bug.
Reports list uses testid 'report-{key}' but no explicit column-toggle or drill-down testids were probed - keep an eye on adding testids for drill row + column toggle popover for e2e coverage.
seed_data_creation: Created test store TEST_STORE_A via masters POST (duplicate assertion). Uploaded Shoppers-Stop synthetic xlsx batches during upload tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green (44/44 e2e + 5/5 unit). Frontend key flows verified via Playwright: login, KPIs, batches hero+rows, reports list, review filter, masters add button, insights, RBAC nav for mgmt. If deeper drill-downs are needed: verify batch detail Mapping Review approve-all flow for Vishal Mega Mart Awaiting Review batch, exception drawer accept/map/ignore actions on /review, and users create flow end-to-end. Upload endpoint is /api/uploads (auth Bearer, multipart 'file'). Audit endpoint is /api/audit-logs not /api/audit.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs discovered. Initial test failure on /api/audit was a test-side path mismatch (correct endpoint is /api/audit-logs); fixed in test file.
